settings.mask_preset.label: Mask preset
settings.mask_preset.description: Choose which area of the wallpaper gets blurred and tinted.
settings.custom_mask.label: Custom mask
settings.custom_mask.description: Transparent PNG. Opaque pixels get blurred and tinted; transparent pixels keep the sharp wallpaper.
settings.blur.label: Blur
settings.blur.description: Blur strength inside the shape, 0-100. 100 is a 40px radius.
settings.tint.label: Tint colour
settings.tint.description: Colour mixed into the blurred area.
settings.tint_intensity.label: Tint strength
settings.tint_intensity.description: How much of the tint colour to mix in, 0-100.
settings.decoration_1.label: Decoration 1 (top)
settings.decoration_2.label: Decoration 2
settings.decoration_3.label: Decoration 3 (bottom)
settings.decoration.description: Optional transparent PNG composited above the blur. Leave empty to skip this layer.
settings.colorize.label: Recolour
settings.colorize.description: Replace this layer's colours with the colour below, keeping its transparency. Leave off for pre-coloured artwork.
settings.color.label: Colour
settings.color.description: Applied only when Recolour is on.
settings.dest_dir.label: Output folder
settings.dest_dir.description: Where the finished images are published. Empty uses the plugin's own data folder.
